limitations.note: The agent fixed the shift direction but changed `match` to compare the newly shifted value rather than the pre-edge register value, moving the match pulse one clock earlier than the reference.
The test updated `expected` before checking `match`, so it confirmed the agent’s same-edge assumption rather than checking that the original registered timing was preserved.
